intermediaryNote: root .il is not registrable at all; only third-level (co.il, org.il...) — co.il itself is open worldwide via registrars, but a root hack like sm.il is impossible
anyone may register at the .uk second level; registrants outside the uk must supply a uk address for service (registrars provide this; businesses qualify without uk presence)
proven connection to ireland required: irish-registered bodies qualify via vat/crn; foreign businesses qualify via registered trademark, trade with ireland, or related connection (iedr categories)
